explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/889, which reports that Erdős–Selfridge showed v₀(n) ≥ 2 for n ≥ 17. The statement is sharper: v₀(n) > 1 for every n outside {0,1,2,3,4,7,8,16}, citing [ErSe67]. Hand checks of the small cases agree: n = 5, 6, 9–15 have v₀ ≥ 2 (e.g. n = 9, k = 1 gives 10 = 2·5), and 7 and 16 are exceptions. It is consistent with and implies the page's statement. Faithful.
